Header: Halticus sp., Harmalia heitensis , Amrasca sp. English- Garden flea hopper, Sinhala- “Kalu keedawa” ; Tamil-“Karuppu ilai thaththikal”, Sinhala –“Sudu Keedawa”; Tamil-“Vellai ilai thathth

Prevention: Establish about 1-2-meter height physical barrier (insect proof net), around the field, before planting
Maintain a fertile soil by addition of compost, organic manures and recommended quantity of fertilizer
At severe infestations prune totally after harvesting and destroy crop residues
Monitoring: Check field regularly for leaf hoppers, especially during dry weather conditions
Look for feeding patches on upper surface of leaves or crimpling of leaves
Observe garden flea hoppers (black colour small insect of about 1 mm, with large hind legs) sitting on leaf edges and jump hastily
Observe black and white hoppers quickly moving on both sides of the leaves
Establish yellow sticky traps just above the leafy vegetable canopy (1/ 100 m2)
Direct Control: Use sweep net to catch leaf hoppers by swiftly moving on the crop canopy
Annona seeds in 0.5 l of water for 24 hours.
Drain and add another 0.5 l of water and mix with 3g of soap.
Spray at 1 week intervals preferably in the evening
Rate of dilution- 40g/16 lit. of water.
Restrictions: Apply only once per cropping cycle
Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
MOA insecticides to maximum of 2 applications per season.
Rate of dilution- 5 g/16 lit. of water.
